input.question: Which country does the Supreme Electoral Tribunal belong to?

documents.text: Supreme Electoral Tribunal (Honduras) The Supreme Electoral Tribunal ("Tribunal Supremo Electoral" in Spanish) is the highest electoral authority, both at the administrative and jurisdictional level in the Republic of Honduras. The Supreme Electoral Tribunal of Honduras deals with everything related to electoral acts and procedures. Integration, organization and operation are governed by the precepts of the Constitution of Honduras and the Electoral and Political Organizations.
